title: Externalize private source work through a clean reviewed public subset
abstract: When separately authorized to externalize a private-origin project, classify candidate inputs privately, approve releasable items individually, rewrite or exclude unsafe material, and create a clean public repository without importing nonpublic Git history, logs or artifacts.

scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only explicitly authorized work on independent public Tarium projects

remarks: Public-source rule normalization reviewed as a distinct project-specific atom; overlapping general rules retained.
